items.title: Sonny Henry Interview, 1959-10-21
items.q: I'm going to tell you the fact that we had the best band in town. The Tursedo.

ctx.x: Was he good especially on Durses or the bass drum and stuff?

Any one of them. Any one of them. They come on and they're dodging. I'm going to tell you the fact that we had the best band in town. The Tursedo. Because you can't find with the bass song. We had the best bass players. We had the best bass tune. We had the best bass tune. And you come on trombone. It was a little tough. And then, you know, both bands had a good drum. You see. And then, after, we had a problem for our band. And, uh, we planned it. Well, I don't tell you. Our band was no doubt that the Tursedo…
Would they have more than one band at a funeral level? Oh, man.
